caption: What if you stacked books off the edge of a table? One book can stick out half its length before it tips. Stack them the smart way, with the top book out by 1/2, the next by 1/4, then 1/6 and 1/8, and with just 4 books the top book hangs completely past the edge. Two book lengths of overhang needs 31 books, three lengths needs 227, and five lengths needs 12,367. The sum 1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + 1/4 ... never stops growing, so in theory the overhang has no limit. The catch: 10 book lengths needs about 27 crore (272 million) books. At 3 cm each, that stack would be over 8,000 km tall, about 20 times higher than the International Space Station. Plot twist: cheat with a counterweight. Two books side by side on one book reach a full length out with only 3 books. How far can YOU stack? 👇
